run_detectron2_training: run detectron2 model training from a config file with a plain training loop
run_detectron2_evaluation: run detectron2 model evaluation on test datasets using the eval_only flag
build_evaluator_for_dataset: build an evaluator for a given dataset type like COCO, LVIS, or Cityscapes
run_inference_on_dataset: run inference on a dataset using a trained model and print CSV results
review_training_loop: review the plain training loop with optimizer, scheduler, and periodic checkpointing
